DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談予約の案内をお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have the consultation appointment information with you, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。これを受け取ったので、申告も終わったと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約を提出済みと誤解したと明かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. After receiving it, I thought my tax return had been submitted as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the appointment for a completed submission. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは相談の予約で、提出済みという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a consultation appointment; it doesn't mean your return has been submitted.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は予約だけ取れている状態ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の手続き状態を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. At this point I only have an appointment, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the current procedural status. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出した書類は別にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you submitted any documents separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありません。作成途中の用紙を家に置いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未提出の途中用紙を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. The form I'm still working on is at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your unfinished form has not been submitted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談のときに持参して内容を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Bring it to the consultation so we can check the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 完成していないことも分かるように、途中のまま持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未完成のまま相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll bring it unfinished so it's clear that it isn't complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to bring the unfinished form for consultation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 収入などの資料もそろえてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also gather your income documents and other supporting materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約案内、途中の用紙、元の資料を分けて準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三種類の持参資料を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll prepare the appointment information, unfinished form, and original supporting documents separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the three types of documents to bring. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、予約日時にその資料をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-NANAO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please bring those materials at your appointment time.

DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 片付けを始めましょう。作品は箱に入りましたか。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's start tidying up. Are your pieces in the box?

DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二つ入れようとしたら、本作品の表面がまだ柔らかいです。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乾き方の違いを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I tried putting both in, I found the surface of the final piece was still soft.
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the difference in how the pieces have dried. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そちらには触れないでください。

DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 試作品だけ先に取り出して、別に包みます。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乾いた作品だけ分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take out only the practice piece first and wrap it separately.
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate only the dry piece. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本作品は置いたまま、担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Leave the final piece where it is; the staff will check it.

DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱のふたもまだ閉じないほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ふたを閉じる時点を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Should I also leave the box lid open for now?
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask when to close the lid. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。こちらでお預かりします。

DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、持ち帰れるのは試作品だけですね。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち帰る対象を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then only the practice piece can go home with me, right?
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm which piece you can take home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本作品の受け取りについては確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain how to collect the final piece after checking it.

DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 試作品に自分の印を付けて、案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 識別して後の案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put my identifying mark on the practice piece and wait for the instructions.
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify the piece and wait for further instructions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本作品はこちらで確認します。道具から片付けてください。
DLG-SC-ISK-WAJIMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check the final piece here. Please start by putting away the tools.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I have the name on the order?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 注文したのは隣の山田さんです。私は受け取りを頼まれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文者と代理受取人を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My neighbor Yamada placed the order. I've been asked to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish the person who ordered from the person collecting on their behalf. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the order slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えです。自分の名前の注文ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 注文控えを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. The order isn't in my own name.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the order slip. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容はこちらの二袋で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are these two bags the correct order?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 山田さんから二袋と聞いています。番号も控えと一致しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋数と番号を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yamada told me there were two bags. The number matches the slip, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the number of bags and the order number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追加のご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like to add anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分用に一品欲しいですが、山田さんの注文には足さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加品を他者の注文から分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like one item for myself, but please don't add it to Yamada's order.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep an additional item separate from someone else's order. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の購入としてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll treat that as a separate purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受取の二袋はそのままにして、自分の一品は別に選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取と自分の購入を順に進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave the two collection bags as they are and choose my own item separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed with collection and your own purchase in sequence. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、注文の受取を確認してから別のお買い物を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll confirm collection of the order before helping with your separate purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このセットでよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三人に分けたいので、何個ずつ入っているか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 配布人数と内容数を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to divide it among three people. How many of each item are included?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the number of recipients and ask about the quantities inside. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二種類が四個ずつです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are four each of two types.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人に一個ずつだと余りますね。余りは自分用にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 余りの用途を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: If I give each person one, there will be some left over. I'll keep the extras for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide what to do with the extras. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、このままでも分けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, you can divide this set as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: もう一種類も一人一個加えたいです。単品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加の単品を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to add one of another type for each person, too. Do you sell individual items?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Look for additional individually sold items. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらなら一個ずつ選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can choose these one at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では三個足して、全部で三人分と自分用に分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三人分の組合せを確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll add three and divide everything into portions for the three people and myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the combination for three recipients. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like separate bags too?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分で詰めるので、小さい袋を三枚お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分で詰める袋を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pack them myself, so three small bags, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for bags to pack the items yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 追加の三個と袋三枚を一緒にご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll prepare the three extra items and three bags together.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交換用の部品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a replacement part?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この写真の工具用です。借り物なので名前が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借り物と不十分な写真を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, for the tool in this photo. It's borrowed, so I don't know its name.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the tool is borrowed and the photo lacks enough information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 型式の表示が写っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The model label isn't visible in the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この形だけでは選べないということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外見だけで選べないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does that mean I can't choose a part based on this shape alone?
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that appearance alone isn't enough to choose. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 似ていても合わない場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It may look similar but still not fit.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち主に型式を聞いてから選びます。売場の場所だけ覚えておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 型式の確認と売場案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask the owner for the model before choosing. For now, I'd just like to remember where the section is.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the model and be shown the sales section. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この棚ですが、適合する品は確認後に探しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's this shelf, but let's look for a compatible item after confirming the model.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は買わずに、必要な表示をメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't buy today. I'll note which label information I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put the purchase on hold. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真は型式と部品の両方があると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Photos showing both the model label and the part would help.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その二か所を撮って送ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加写真を依頼すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask them to photograph those two places and send the photos to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to request additional photos. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 情報がそろったら、また一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you have the information, let's check again together.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お忘れ物の問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about lost property?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、友人が私の袋について連絡しました。連絡先を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既存問い合わせの連絡先変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday my friend contacted you about my bag. I'd like to change the contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to change the contact details on an existing inquiry. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 届いたとの連絡はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you been notified that it has been turned in?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだありません。友人は今日から電話に出にくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 代理人が連絡困難になると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Starting today, it will be difficult for my friend to answer the phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that it will become difficult to reach the person acting on your behalf. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付内容を確認する手がかりはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have any details to help us find the inquiry record?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 問い合わせた時刻と、袋の特徴をメモしてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 照合できる情報を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've noted the time of the inquiry and the bag's features.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Provide details that can be matched to the record. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持ち主ご本人の番号を確認してから、担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll confirm the owner's own number and pass it to the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の番号はこちらです。友人の番号と取り違えないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の番号を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is my number. Please make sure it isn't confused with my friend's.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify the owner's own number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 読み上げて確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll read it back to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その番号で合っています。見つかっていないことも承知しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号と未発見状態を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, that's the correct number. I also understand that the bag hasn't been found.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the number and that the item is still missing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先変更の希望を引き継ぎます。発見の確認は別途となります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on your request to change the contact details. Confirmation of finding the bag is a separate matter.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 追加はこの三品ですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ全部は頼みません。家族が少し満腹になってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追加三品の未確定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I won't order all of them yet. My family is starting to feel a little full.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the three additional dishes are not yet confirmed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、確定する品はどれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which dish would you like to confirm now?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 野菜だけです。肉二品は、今ある分を食べてから考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 確定する一品と保留二品を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only the vegetables. We'll consider the two meat dishes after eating what we already have.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the one confirmed dish from the two on hold. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、野菜一品を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I'll take the order for one vegetable dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取り分けの人数は三人ですが、皿を三つに増やさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 人数と皿数を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three people will share it, but please don't increase it to three plates.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the number of people from the number of plates. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家族にも、肉はまだ注文していないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ未注文の品を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll also tell my family that the meat hasn't been ordered yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your family which items have not been ordered. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 追加したいときは改めてお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please call us again if you would like to add anything.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。量を見て、一品ずつ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残量を見て段階的に追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I see. We'll look at how much is left and ask about adding one dish at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Add dishes gradually after checking the amount remaining. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今回は野菜一皿だけ承りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've taken only one plate of vegetables this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族から何か伝言はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a message from your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 姉が、母に新しい服を着せてほしいと言っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族から預かった要望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My older sister said she'd like our mother to wear the new clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Pass on a request from a family member. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お母様ご本人も希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does your mother want that herself, too?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ聞いていません。姉の希望としてお伝えしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の未確認を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't asked her yet. I'm passing it on as my sister's request.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that the person's own preference has not been checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の気持ちも確認したいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'd like to check how she feels, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日、私から服を見せて好みを聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人へ好みを尋ねると提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today I'll show her the clothes and ask what she likes.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suggest asking the person about her preference. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 着替えの対応は職員と相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please discuss assistance with changing clothes with the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。服は勝手に棚へ入れず、まずお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職員と衣類の扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. Rather than put the clothes on the shelf on my own, I'll show them to you first.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss how to handle the clothes with the staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 名前は付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are they labeled with her name?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだです。受け入れ方と名前の付け方も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 識別の準備不足を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I'd also like to discuss how the clothes are accepted and how to label them.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that identifying labels have not been prepared yet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、服を確認しながら順に相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's discuss each point while checking the clothes.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封書についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about this sealed letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父宛てです。本人が留守なので、どう渡せばいいか聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人宛て未開封の封書を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's addressed to my father. He's away, so I came to ask how to pass it to him.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show an unopened letter addressed to the person concerned. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封は開いていないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it hasn't been opened, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。中身を知らないので、手続きの期限も分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 内容と期限の不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I don't know the contents, so I don't know the deadline for any procedure either.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that both the contents and deadline are unknown. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人に封書を確認していただく必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your father needs to check the letter himself.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、私が内容を聞いて代わりに処理することはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代行をしないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't ask about its contents and deal with it on his behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide not to act on his behalf. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お父様はご連絡が取れますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話できます。封書が届いたことを先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人への連絡方法を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can phone him. I'll first tell him that a letter has arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you can contact the person concerned. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本人からの問い合わせ方法はご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can explain how he can make an inquiry himself.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その案内をもらって、封書と一緒に渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内と封書を渡すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take those instructions and give them to him with the letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to pass on the instructions and letter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、問い合わせの案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-ISK-WAJIMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll give you the inquiry instructions.

DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご利用で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help with your visit?

DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三人で来ましたが、一人は入浴せず待ちます。待てる場所を先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三人のうち一人は入浴せず待つため待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: Three of us came, but one person will wait without bathing. I'd like to check where they can wait first.
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a waiting place because one of three visitors will wait without bathing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入浴するのはお二人ですね。同行者は受付の外の休憩席でお待ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Two of you will bathe, then. Your companion can wait in the resting seats outside reception.

DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人だけ入浴します。待つ人も浴室へ付いて行くのではなく、外の席にいます。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入浴二人、同行者は浴室ではなく外の席で待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only two of us will bathe. The person waiting will stay in the seats outside rather than accompany us into the bathing area.
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that two will bathe and the companion will wait outside rather than in the bathing area. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、外の席をご利用ください。入浴するお二人の受付をしましょうか。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, please use the seats outside. Shall we check in the two who will bathe?

DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。三人分の入浴券を買いそうになったので、二人分にしてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入浴券は三人分ではなく二人分を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please. I nearly bought bathing tickets for three, so please make it two.
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request bathing tickets for two rather than three. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二人分で承ります。お待ちの方とは、どこで合流しますか。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Two, certainly. Where will you meet the person waiting?

DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この受付前で合流します。待つ人に荷物を全部任せず、自分たちの荷物は案内の場所へしまいます。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付前で合流し、自分たちの荷物は同行者に全て任せず指定場所へしまうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: In front of this reception desk. Rather than leave all our belongings with the person waiting, we'll store our own things in the designated place.
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will meet in front of reception and store your own belongings in the designated place rather than leave everything to your companion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付前でお待合せですね。休憩席は待つ方の荷物で広く占めないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: You'll meet in front of reception, then. Please don't spread the waiting person's belongings across the resting seats.

DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同行者に待つ席と合流場所を伝えました。入浴は二人で、終わったら受付前へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者へ席と合流場所を伝え、二人で入浴後に受付前へ戻ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've told our companion which seats to wait in and where to meet. Two of us will bathe, then return to the front of reception.
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm telling the companion the seats and meeting place and that the two bathers will return to reception afterward. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お二人の受付をしました。ご利用ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-IWT-HANAMAKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I've checked in the two of you. Thank you for using our facilities.
